blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) has sought nearly P10 billion in additional funding to mitigate the effects of El Niño and rising fuel prices on local agricultural production. Agriculture Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa said the Department of Budget and Management already released P6.2 billion in fuel and fertilizer subsidies for eligible […]...
